user.title: Sign in to Odecty vodomeru
user.description: Use your odectyvodomeru.cz credentials. Next, choose which meters to add with cumulative reading sensors.

meters.title: Select meters
meters.description: Select at least one meter to add as a device with reading sensors. Nothing is selected automatically.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Enter valid credentials for the same odectyvodomeru.cz account.

error.access_restricted: The portal denied access to this account. Check that you can sign in on odectyvodomeru.cz.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the portal. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: The username or password was rejected.
error.invalid_response: The portal returned an unexpected response. Its API may have changed.
error.rate_limited: The portal is limiting requests. Wait before trying again.
error.no_meters: No supported active water or heat meters were found. Check your account access on the portal, then try again.
error.invalid_selection: Select only meters from the available list.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: Sign in with the same account that was originally configured.

init.title: Select meters
init.description: Choose the meters to use. Existing choices are checked. Saving adds selected devices and sensors and removes deselected ones. If discovery failed, submit again to retry.

error.access_restricted: The portal denied access to this account.
error.invalid_auth: The username or password was rejected.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the portal. Submit again to retry.
error.invalid_response: The portal returned an unexpected response. Its API may have changed.
error.rate_limited: The portal is limiting requests. Wait before trying again.
error.no_meters: No supported active water or heat meters were found. Check your account access, then submit again to retry.
error.invalid_selection: Select only meters from the available list.

abort.reauth_required: Sign in again using the integration's reauthentication prompt, then reopen Configure.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The portal returned a different account. Sign in with the originally configured account.
